artworks.title: Dress Rehearsal at the Folies-Bergere (Répétition générale aux Folies-Bergère)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image depicts two people. One individual is shown from head to toe, facing left, while the other is only partially shown, mostly obscured by shadows. The person on the left is standing, in an animated position, with their face turned toward the other figure. They have short hair. The other person has curly or wavy hair. The visible figure wears a flowing dress or coat, suggesting fabric texture and movement. The setting is dark and sketchy, with a mysterious atmosphere, possibly an interior scene with indistinct shadows in the background. There is a mark or signature at the bottom left. There are no discernible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Folies-Bergere: The Censors of M. Prudhomme (Folies-Bergère: Les pudeurs de M. Prudhomme)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a dynamic full-body scene. Two women are dressed in light-colored garments with dark collars and styled hair. They are dancing with a man wearing a suit and bow tie, leaning backwards. In the background, there is a standing figure that appears almost ghostly, to the left. The setting is a wooden floor with a textured and shaded background, giving a sense of a dim interior space. The figures are illustrated in a sketch-like manner.

artworks.title: At the Renaissance: Sarah Bernhardt in "Phedre" (A la Renaissance: Sarah Bernhardt dans "Phèdre")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up in a closely connected pose. The upper figure is facing slightly to the left, with their face slightly turned and eyes looking upward. Their hair is covered with a veiling drapery, and they are wearing a garment adorned with circular motifs. The lower figure is positioned below the upper one, with more pronounced facial features and deep-set eyes. They are wearing a wrap or garment that drapes around their head and shoulders. One of their hands is visible, appearing to be holding the upper figure's hand. The background is minimally detailed, shaded with arcs suggesting a shadowy environment.

artworks.title: At the Theatre-Libre: Antoine in "L'inquiétude" (Au Théatre-Libre: Antoine dans "L'inquiétude")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals engaged in conversation. The man on the left is shown in profile, wearing a cap and jacket. The woman on the right faces him, holding a lantern or lamp. They are depicted in a sparsely decorated interior with dim lighting and shadows.

artworks.title: At the Opera: Mme. Caron in "Faust" (A l'opéra: Mme. Caron dans "Faust")
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a theater or stage setting. The central figure is positioned facing forward with a stern expression and closed, thin lips. They have stylized hair and wear a dress with puffed sleeves. To their left, a second person wears a large brimmed hat and puffed shorts. They look towards the central figure with an open mouth. Behind them, a third person stands in a contrapposto stance with a hand on their hip. The background is textured and monochromatic with abstract shadowy forms suggesting depth or an interior location.

artworks.title: Lugne Poe and Baldy in "Au-dessus des forces humaines" (Lugne Poe et Baldy dans "Au-desses des forces humaines")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two women. The woman on the left is leaning forward with her hands on an unseen surface. She has a softly drawn facial profile, and her hair is cropped close to her head. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a high collar. The woman on the right stands with her arms raised and hands clasped behind her head. Her facial features are less distinct, and she wears a long-sleeved dress. The background is minimal, with faintly sketched structural elements.

artworks.title: Mlle. Lender in "Madame Satan" (Mlle. Lender dans "Madame Satan")
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals shown from the torso upwards. The person on the left is in a three-quarter pose, turned slightly towards the figure on the right, with their head turned to the side. This person has delicate facial features and their hair appears to be styled up. They are wearing a garment with puffed shoulders and a prominent black, circular feature at the neckline. The person on the right is standing facing forward but slightly turned towards the left figure. This figure also has delicate features, with their head slightly raised. They are dressed in a jacket with structured shoulders and a high collar. Both individuals appear to be interacting, with soft and loose lines suggesting movement. The background is lightly textured and splattered paper.

artworks.title: Ida Heath at the Bar (Ida Heath au bar)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals depicted from the waist up, positioned closely facing each other. The person on the right has a rounded nose, wears a high top hat, and holds a cane in their right hand. They are dressed in a suit coat with a visible white shirt and necktie. The other individual is less defined, wearing a draped garment. In the background, there is a wall with subtle shading and some vague shapes. The drawing has a light and unfinished quality with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Brandes and Le Bargy in "Cabotins" (Brandès et Les Bargy dans "Cabotins")
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two figures. One figure is partially visible, standing with an arm extended downwards, holding a hat. The second figure is seated, resting an elbow on a surface and leaning the head on one hand. The background includes outlines of other figures in different poses, possibly sculptures or artworks, as well as furniture or structural details. The sketch is rendered in soft pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Brandes and Leloir in "Cabotins" (Brandès et Leloir dans "Cabotins")
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman in a partial body shot. The man is facing slightly towards the woman, with long hair styled back and a distinctive facial profile. He is dressed in a suit with a collar and tie. The woman stands beside him, facing partially towards him, with delicate facial features and an elegant updo. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves and a high collar, a necklace around her neck, and holds an object, possibly a fan, in one hand. The background is plain with faint sketching.

artworks.title: Antoine and Gémier in "Une Faillite"
artworks.medium: lithograph on velin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from head to toe. The person on the left is standing, with their side facing the viewer. They have chin-length hair and appear to be wearing glasses. They are dressed in a long dark coat and pants. Their hands are not visible. The person on the right is facing slightly towards the left and appears to be standing as well. Only the outline of their facial features and hair can be seen. Their jacket has a subtle point indicating that their hands might be behind their back. The background features faint lines that could depict a window or frame with a table or desk on the left side, on top of which rests a few indistinct objects. The overall setting appears sketched with minimal detail, and the background is light.

artworks.title: Carnival (Carnaval)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green and red on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in profile, focusing on their upper bodies and facial features. The figure on the left has delicate features, defined lips, light curly hair, and a ruffled collar garment. The figure on the right has angular features, dark hair, and one visible hand. The background is plain with scattered spots, along with handwritten text and a small emblem-like signature at the bottom.

artworks.title: La Tige (Moulin-Rouge)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring multiple figures. In the foreground, there are two central people. The woman on the left is seated, turned slightly to the right, with a distinct profile. The man on the right is standing, leaning slightly forward, and depicted in a three-quarter view. In the background, there are several loosely sketched figures, two of whom wear top hats. The setting appears to be a casual, social environment with sketch lines suggesting an interior space.

artworks.title: Terror of Grenelle (La terreur de Grenelle)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a room. The person on the left is illustrated from the mid-torso upwards, wearing a cap and facing away, showing only a partial side profile with short hair. To the right, two more persons are seated, shown from a side angle. They have distinctive facial profiles with prominent noses and individualized hairstyles; one appears to have a bun or topknot. The individuals' clothing is suggested with simple lines, contributing to their form without intricate details, one wearing a hat. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. In the background, a suggestion of vertical lines represents paneling or wall details.

artworks.title: Terror of Grenelle (La terreur de Grenelle)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring the upper bodies of three figures closely positioned as if in conversation. The figure on the left wears a hat and a loose-fitting coat and is facing to the side. The middle figure is seated and has prominent facial features like a nose and lips, with an updo hairstyle. The third figure, partially visible behind the seated one, also has an updo and less defined facial features. The background is lightly sketched, suggesting an interior space with vertical lines resembling wall paneling or wallpaper. There are no visible accessories or objects being held. The sketch is done in a minimalist, monochromatic style on beige paper with a red stamp or signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Adolphe or the Sad Young Man (Adolphe ou le jeune homme triste)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a man standing with a slight lean in his posture. His head is tilted forward, giving a subtle slouch to his stance. The man's facial features are lightly drawn, with prominent cheekbones and a focused expression. He has short dark hair styled to the side. The man is dressed in a formal suit with a waistcoat and cravat, typical of 19th-century fashion. It appears he may be holding a cape or coat over his arm. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is minimalistic, with faint sketch lines hinting at an indistinct setting, possibly outdoors. The paper is speckled with small, faint marks.

artworks.title: Wounded Eros (Eros vanné)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of three figures at a bar. Two figures are standing or leaning against the bar's countertop, visible from the waist up. The person on the left has a distinct profile with a prominent nose and chin, wearing a dark hat and a coat with a fur collar. Their hair is styled in soft curls peeking from under the hat. Beside them, a person is leaning slightly towards the left, with their face turned towards the viewer, featuring sharp facial features and dark hair adorned with bows. They are wearing a garment with a fur-trimmed collar and appear to be holding a small glass in one hand. In front of them, there is a seated figure visible from the chest up to the knee, with a bandaged head and minimal clothing, holding a crutch. They are facing slightly away from the other two figures. The background includes an amorphous countertop with an indistinct bottle, establishing a bar setting.

artworks.title: Wounded Eros (Eros vanné)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a partial view of a person's body, focusing primarily on their upper torso and one extended leg. The figure appears to be in a seated position, slightly bent forward. The person's facial features are roughly outlined, showing a side profile with a prominent nose and visible lips. Their hair seems to be tied back or covered by a cloth. The sketch does not distinctly show any particular clothing, but features more focused on the body contours. The left leg is extended outward with detail given to its structure and musculature. There is a sketchy outline of what seems like a wooden crutch beside the upper body. The background consists of a plain space with no additional elements or context present, emphasizing the figure as the central focus.

artworks.title: The Old Gentlemen (Les vieux messieurs)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a side profile of two people from about the knees up. The person on the right is positioned with her back slightly turned. She has a refined facial structure with her hair styled upward and adorned with small embellishments. She is dressed in a gown with dark fur trim around the shoulders and is holding a large, rounded object. The person on the left, partially obscured and facing toward the viewer, has a prominent mustache and is wearing a tall top hat. Both figures appear to be dressed in formal or elaborate clothing. The background of the image is mostly blank, filled with light speckles.

artworks.title: German Babylon (Babylone d'Allemagne)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black and beige on velin paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a mounted figure and soldiers. The image displays negative space, with a blank area on the left and an illustration on the right featuring a soldier on a horse and additional figures in a uniformed parade. The figures are outlined in a minimalist style with muted colors. A set of diagonal lines partitions the image.

artworks.title: Le Chariot de terre cuite
artworks.medium: lithograph in blue and rose on velin paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical program poster. The composition includes a stylized column intertwined with floral vines and a figure in a dynamic pose. The left side features text elements, such as the title "Le Chariot de Terre Cuite" and a list of characters' names with their performers. The right side displays abstract motifs and a human figure. The piece shows aesthetic elements of the Art Nouveau movement, seen in the decorative motifs and flow of natural forms.

artworks.title: Advertisement for the Album "Yvette Guilbert"
artworks.medium: woodcut in black
artworks.description: The image is a promotional poster for the book "Yvette Guilbert" by Gustave Geffroy and illustrations by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec. The poster features Art Nouveau stylized text and imagery. The centerpiece is a stylized silhouette of an extended arm and hand on a cream background. Text about the book's details, price, and publication are creatively arranged around the image. The style is reminiscent of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert
artworks.medium: lithograph in light green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view sketch of a person from the waist up. The person is drawn facing left, holding a long object. Their facial features are softly outlined, with a notable nose and a slight smile. The hair is straight and medium length, possibly tucked under a hat with a feather or fur trim. The individual is wearing a checkered coat or dress with a high collar, buttons, and gloves. The background is plain. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature that reads "Yvette Guilbert," followed by a partial date.

artworks.title: Footit and Chocolat (Footit et Chocolat) [left recto]
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an audience watching a performance. The drawing shows two dancers, one in an ornate costume with expressive posture, and the other in motion. The audience appears entertained in the background. The line work is loose and expressive. There are French phrases and narrative text in the drawing, similar to the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.
